title: Copilot Studio: cost visibility in agent evaluations

claims.where: controls[1].api; controls[1].note; Governance controls: second row
claims.claim: PUT /licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 writes the environment allocation and tenant-pool draw configuration.
claims.quote:
$apiVersion    = "2024-10-01"
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put `
    -Uri "$apiBaseUrl/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=$apiVersion"
claims.fix: Keep the call unchanged. Add to controls[1].note and the rendered row: 'The request body targets scope.environmentId; allocatedEntitlements uses entitlementId MCSMessages, allocation.quantity and enforcementRules with ruleType TenantPool and enabled false to disable tenant-capacity draw.' The cited allocation tutorial documents these properties.

claims.claim: Capacity management requires Power Platform Administrator, Global Administrator or an equivalent role that manages licensing and capacity.
claims.quote: To manage Copilot Studio capacity, you need the Power Platform Administrator or Global Administrator role, or an equivalent role that can manage licensing and capacity.

claims.quote: When you publish a rule, it governs every environment in the group. The environment-level setting becomes read-only in the Power Platform admin center

claims.claim: API attempts to override a published group rule are rejected with TenantPoolLockedByPolicy.
claims.quote: Updates through the Power Platform admin center, Power Platform API, or administration SDKs are rejected with the TenantPoolLockedByPolicy error.

claims.claim: The allocation API base URL is https://api.powerplatform.com.
claims.quote: $apiBaseUrl    = "https://api.powerplatform.com"
